SQLite is in the public domain. The vendored sqlite3.h and sqlite3ext.h are
the official SQLite public headers (SQLite 3.53.4); they are retained
unchanged under SQLite's public-domain dedication. Source and licensing:
https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

Realm does not link a second SQLite library. The extension receives the
sqlite3_api_routines table from the host SQLite instance at load time.
